notes.title: Mental: The Dark Night Beta 3.7.2 is here
notes.notes:
[p]🌑 [b]Darkness is calling! Join the exclusive Beta of [i]Mental: The Dark Night[/i]![/b]  
· Only a few will have the privilege of diving into this psychological experience before its official release [i](Unscheduled date)[/i].  

· Beta Update 3.7.2 offers a preview of the [b]first chapter of Story Mode[/b], where you'll explore your way, solve puzzles your style, and investigate the paranormal freely.  
[/p][p]🛠 [b]What's included in Beta 3.7.2?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]First part of the first chapter of the first Story Mode:[/b]  
Immerse yourself in the origins of a psychological thriller full of mystery and tension, exploring an abandoned house deep in the forest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixes and improvements:[/b]  
Gameplay, graphics, and sound have been optimized for a smoother and more immersive experience. Mental has been updated to Unreal Engine version 5.5.4. Additionally, it includes automatic support for DLSS and FSR, adapting to your graphics card for optimized performance without sacrificing visual quality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Your feedback matters:[/b]  
Help shape the individual development of [i]Mental[/i] by participating as you explore a dark and oppressive world.
